subject: Re: Quick demo request — status update and next steps
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novusanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick demo request — possible times next week

Hi Alex,

Following up from our intro call — would love to walk you and the team through a 30-minute demo of Redwood Inference focused on latency and cost metrics for batch vs. streaming inference.

Is Thursday 2026-05-07 at 11:00 AM PT or Friday 2026-05-08 at 10:00 AM PT better for you? I’ll include Marissa (solutions engineer) so we can cover architecture details if you like.

Agenda (30 mins):
- 5m intros and goals
- 15m targeted demo (throughput/latency, quantization options)
- 10m Q&A + next steps / PoC checklist

If those times don’t work, send a couple windows that do and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: demo-deck-stub.pdf (attachment referenced for agenda)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novusanalytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sales Ops <salesops@novusanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T14:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — possible times next week

Connor —

Thanks for the quick follow up and for proposing times. I hate to do this, but we need to put the LLM/inference initiative on the back burner for the next quarter. Two things happened internally: our product roadmap got pushed to prioritize a compliance-heavy feature (security upgrade) and our head of infra is traveling for three weeks starting next week, so we don’t have the bandwidth to evaluate new infra partners right now.

Can we cancel the demo for now? I’d like to keep the conversation open — would it be OK if I ask you to check back in about 6–8 weeks? If anything on our side changes sooner I’ll let you know.

Appreciate the outreach, and apologies for the flip.

Best,
Alex Turner
Senior Product Manager | Novus Analytics
alex.turner@novusanalytics.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novusanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T08:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — possible times next week

Alex —

Totally understandable, thanks for the heads up and for the context. No problem cancelling the demo for now — I’ll remove the invite.

If it helps while you wait on capacity, I can:
- Share a 1-page cost/latency snapshot tailored to the sample you shared on our last call
- Send a short recording of a 15-minute architecture walkthrough Marissa recorded (covers dedicated vs hosted and private deployment patterns)
- Block a tentative follow-up check-in for the week of 2026-06-22 (no calendar invite until you confirm)

Which of those would be most useful for you and your team? If you prefer, I can also touch base with Sales Ops directly to coordinate timing once you’re ready.

Appreciate it — and I’ll stay flexible.

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com

Marissa — quick note to confirm next steps after Alex’s cancelation:

- I cancelled the scheduled demo and removed the invites (Thursday/Friday).
- I offered a 1-pager and a short recording; Alex asked us to check back in ~6–8 weeks.
- Action: please save the 15-min arch walkthrough recording to our shared demo folder and I’ll link it in HubSpot. Also can you draft a 1-page snapshot (cost vs latency) based on the sample metrics Alex shared in the intro call? I’ll push both to the prospect thread when ready.

I’ll log the status in HubSpot as "Deferred - prospect reprioritized" and set a follow-up task for 2026-06-22. Deal ID NV-2891.

Connor
